BrochureContent.Content:
O'Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are delighted to present this turnkey three-bedroom end-of-terrace residence, ideally situated in the heart of Caltra Village.

Enjoying a prime village-centre location, this property is perfect for buyers seeking the convenience of having essential amenities within walking distance. 

Nearby amenities include Caltra National School, Our Lady of Lourdes Church, and Caltra GAA Club, making it an excellent choice for families and those looking for a peaceful community setting.

Features include a storage shed to the rear, ample parking facilities, and annual management fees of approximately 500.

Conveniently located, Ballinasloe is just a 20-minute drive away, while Athlone can be reached in approximately 40 minutes and Galway City Centre in just 55 minutes.

Accommodation comprises an entrance hall, a spacious open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area, a generously sized utility room with rear access, and a ground-floor bathroom.

Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, all featuring built-in wardrobes. 

The master bedroom benefits from an en-suite bathroom, while a separate family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms.

Viewing is highly recommended & guaranteed not to disappoint.
